andrea-stewart-cousins.notes: Official Senate headshot (the 4:3 member photo on her page). nysenate.gov serves a Cloudflare challenge to scripts, so the file was retrieved from the Wayback Machine snapshot of the same URL (web.archive.org/web/20261019041751/...). Front-facing, broad smile, short dark hair with grey, gold earrings and chain, colorful scarf over one shoulder, flag behind.
